self_tests.name: one chat turn: the workflow starts and answers
self_tests.detail: Hello, this is a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with test test?

notes.message: rules: 51 rules (26 fit no slot and go to the prompts only), 18 endings, 2 bands
step texts: fixed instructions plus the brief's rules word for word (no model call)
limit identity.wrong_limit = 3: route on the bank's own count (wrong_answers_left) (identity)
limit promise.failure_limit = 2: counted per product in the tool's hook; one product: route to the closing step (collect, collect_after_offer)
limit every product gets a promise or a note = 1: list kept in the tool hooks; route when none is open (collect, collect_after_offer)
limit floor_offer.limit = 1: counted_step (fixed line, said on entry) (floor_gate)
limit attempts (band early) = 1: prompt_only, with the allowed number and each proposal computed in code (collect)
limit attempts (band late) = 2: prompt_only, with the allowed number and each proposal computed in code (collect)
build time without practice customers: 9 s
